case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB

faults.what: An unrequested additional '2027' is appended to the headline.
The required comma after 'Road' is missing, so the address is not preserved letter for letter.
Address lettering is visibly malformed around 'John's Road' and 'Thames', compromising the required comfortable legibility.

judge.summary: The black-and-cream flyer has a clean layout and correct date and time, but adds a year to the headline and fails to reproduce the address cleanly and exactly.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both are present and readable as requested.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order; line breaks are permitted.
must_haves.why: The address broadly follows the requested order, but the comma after 'Road' is absent and some lettering is malformed.

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: The range dash and period are visible, but the comma after 'Road' is missing and the lettering around the possessive is degraded.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The address is inside the canvas and not abbreviated, but distorted characters in the final two lines prevent comfortable legibility.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: The portrait 4:5 format and black-and-cream palette are correct, but the headline contains an extra '2027'.
